feedback: The test cases directly and unambiguously verify the left-to-right evaluation of operators of equal precedence as required by requirement R006. Test R006-T01 (3 - 5 - 2) correctly evaluates to -4, demonstrating left-to-right subtraction. Test R006-T02 (10 / 2 / 5) correctly evaluates to 1, demonstrating left-to-right division. Both cases are mathematically validated by reference checks, and the scope covers the specific requirement of left-to-right evaluation for operators with equal precedence (subtraction and division). The tests include valid, simple expressions that clearly expose the left-to-right behavior without introducing ambiguity or complexity. The justification and reference checks confirm correctness. Coverage is sufficient and aligned with the customer intent.
